name: Zen Wallpaper
author: modpunk (omarchy.fans)
description: Turn a long-form YouTube mood stream (lofi, zen, ambient) into your Omarchy wallpaper: animated with sound, or a fresh still every day. One click asks Aether to build an Omarchy theme from the current scene.

barWidget.description: Zen chip: play or pause the stream wallpaper, mute it, grab a still, or make an Aether theme from the scene.

schema.label: Tell me when a new version is published
